meta.project: ERP Foundation Backend Modules (Common Utils & File Service)

product_overview: A backend-only ERP foundation platform providing shared runtime configuration management and reusable file services. It supports secure file uploads, categorized document handling, and short-lived download access tokens, all protected by authentication.
core_goals: Allow operators to create, read, update, search, and deactivate runtime configuration entries without redeployment.
Provide reusable file category management for classifying uploaded documents across modules.
Support secure file upload, metadata retrieval, listing, deletion/archiving, and token-based download access.
Expose lookup values for file-related UI or consuming modules.
Enforce authenticated access across all configuration and file endpoints.

features.name: Common Configurations (CU)
features.description: Manage application runtime key/value configuration entries through authenticated REST APIs, including creation, retrieval, search, update, and deactivation.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/common/configurations with a new configKey and configValue -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<ConfigurationResponse> containing the saved configuration -> GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} -> Receive 200 with the persisted configuration data

POST /api/v1/common/configurations with a configKey that already exists -> Receive 400 validation error for duplicate key -> GET /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} for the existing key -> Receive 200 with the current configuration

POST /api/v1/common/configurations/search with filters, page, and size -> Receive 200 with a paginated list of matching configurations -> PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} with updated configValue and notes -> Receive 200 with the updated configuration
PUT /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} for a non-existent key -> Receive 404 not found -> DELETE /api/v1/common/configurations/{configKey} for the same key -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: File Categories
features.description: Create, search, retrieve, update, and deactivate file/document categories used to classify uploaded files.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files/categories with categoryCode, bilingual names, and optional limits -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<CategoryResponse> containing the new category -> GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} -> Receive 200 with the saved category details

POST /api/v1/files/categories with missing required fields or invalid values -> Receive 400 validation error -> POST /api/v1/files/categories/search with filters, page, and size -> Receive 200 with a paginated category list
PUT /api/v1/files/categories/{id} with updated nameAr and nameEn -> Receive 200 with the updated category -> DELETE /api/v1/files/categories/{id} -> Receive 204 no content to deactivate the category
GET /api/v1/files/categories/{id} for a non-existent category -> Receive 404 not found -> PUT /api/v1/files/categories/{id} for the same id -> Receive 404 not found

features.name: File Management
features.description: Upload files with ownership metadata, issue short-lived access tokens, download files securely, retrieve file metadata, list owned files, and archive or delete files.
user_flows: POST /api/v1/files as multipart/form-data with file, ownerId, ownerType, moduleCode, and optional fileCategoryFk -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<FileMetadataResponse> for the uploaded file -> POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<AccessTokenResponse> containing a short-lived token -> GET /api/v1/files/download?token={token} -> Receive 200 with binary file content
POST /api/v1/files as multipart/form-data missing ownerId or ownerType or moduleCode -> Receive 400 validation error -> GET /api/v1/files/{id} for the failed upload reference -> Receive 404 not found
GET /api/v1/files/{id} -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<FileMetadataResponse> -> GET /api/v1/files -> Receive 200 with a paginated list of the current user's files
POST /api/v1/files/{id}/access-token for a non-existent file -> Receive 404 not found -> GET /api/v1/files/download?token=expiredOrInvalidToken -> Receive 401 invalid or expired token

DELETE /api/v1/files/{id} -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<FileMetadataResponse> showing the archived or deleted file state -> GET /api/v1/files/{id} for the same file -> Receive 404 not found or the post-delete state as implemented

features.name: File Lookups
features.description: Retrieve lookup option lists for file type and file status values used by file-related consumers.
user_flows: GET /api/v1/files/lookups/FILE_FILE_TYPE -> Receive 200 with ApiResponse<LookupOptionResponse[]> containing IMAGE, DOCUMENT, SPREADSHEET, ARCHIVE, and OTHER -> GET /api/v1/files/lookups/FILE_FILE_STATUS -> Receive 200 with ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, and DELETED options
GET /api/v1/files/lookups/UNKNOWN_LOOKUP_KEY -> Receive 404 not found for an invalid lookup key -> GET /api/v1/files/lookups/FILE_FILE_TYPE -> Receive 200 with the valid file type options

features.name: Common Configurations (CU)
features.description: Key-value system configuration management, exposed via com.erp.cu module

response_schema.200: ApiResponse<ConfigurationResponse> (response body has a top-level "data" object containing configKey/configValue/notes)

endpoints.description: Update an existing configuration entry by configKey
Get a configuration entry by configKey
Deactivate a configuration entry by configKey

features.name: File Categories
features.description: CRUD for file/document categories used to classify uploaded files

body.categoryCode: string (required, max 50, immutable after creation, example "CONTRACTS")

response_schema.200: ApiResponse<CategoryResponse> (response body has a top-level "data" object)

endpoints.description: Get a file category by id
Update a file category by id (categoryCode is immutable and NOT part of the update body)
Deactivate a file category by id

features.name: File Management
features.description: Upload, download, metadata retrieval, listing and deletion of files

endpoints.description: Upload a new file. multipart/form-data with a "file" part (the binary) PLUS the following form fields bound via @ModelAttribute (NOT a JSON body): ownerId (required, Long, example 1001), ownerType (required, string, example "PURCHASE_ORDER"), moduleCode (required, string, example "PROC"), fileCategoryFk (optional, Long id of an existing file category — create a category first via POST /api/v1/files/categories and use its returned id here if exercising this field).
Issue a short-lived access token for downloading a file
Download a file using a previously issued access token
List files owned by the current user, paginated
Archive or delete a file by id

features.name: File Lookups
features.description: Lookup/option lists used by File module UI dropdowns

endpoints.description: Get lookup options by lookup key. Only two lookupKey values exist and are valid: "FILE_FILE_TYPE" (returns IMAGE, DOCUMENT, SPREADSHEET, ARCHIVE, OTHER) and "FILE_FILE_STATUS" (returns ACTIVE, ARCHIVED, DELETED). Any other key returns 404.

known_limitations.issue: com.erp.common package provides only shared infrastructure (AuditableEntity, ApiResponse envelope, SpecBuilder, exceptions) with no REST endpoints of its own
known_limitations.impact: No standalone endpoints to test under "common"; its behavior is exercised indirectly through CU and FILE endpoints
